candidates.decision_relevance: Would show whether reported breadth changes reflect persistent participation shifts rather than changing proxy membership or isolated captures.
candidates.evidence_reference: Daily outputs for 2026-10-08 through 2026-10-11: breadth is proxy-only, point-in-time, and often uses differing membership hashes; W37 review also notes missing breadth construction and sequence.
candidates.metric_name: Constituent-level daily breadth observations on a consistently defined universe
candidates.missing_history_problem: The reports provide aggregate breadth snapshots, but changing memberships and irregular capture times prevent a comparable historical participation series.

candidates.decision_relevance: Would permit retrospective evaluation of forecast range containment, error, and sharpness against the original frozen candidates without relying on completed-path summaries.
candidates.evidence_reference: W40 and W39 weekly reviews report unavailable candidate-level scoring, bounds, and outcomes; daily outputs contain unratified candidates with explicit horizons and bounds or move targets.
candidates.metric_name: Candidate-linked realized outcomes and scoring from frozen forecast specifications
candidates.missing_history_problem: Candidate specifications, issuance times, and matured metric-path outcomes are not joined in the supplied reviews, so forecast performance and broad-range containment cannot be audited.

candidates.decision_relevance: Would allow descriptive comparison of subsequent market paths after prospectively timestamped warnings, addressing the repeatedly unresolved warning timing and post-warning outcome questions.
candidates.evidence_reference: W40 review reports zero eligible prospective typed protection outcomes and missing warning timestamps and subsequent outcomes; W37 and earlier reviews likewise report no matured warning series.
candidates.metric_name: Timestamped warning observations linked to subsequent realized price paths
candidates.missing_history_problem: The supplied record lacks a prospective warning-to-outcome history, leaving false-positive, late-recognition, and post-warning path analyses unavailable.
